metadata.author: October 24, 2004 - Triple Play by Seth A. Abel, edited by Fred Piscop

entries.clue: Why go-getters, paparazzi and astronomers are alike?
Why odds-on favorites, boiled eggs, and broken drums are alike?
Why virtuoso performers, tornadoes and card counters are alike?
Why rodeo photographers, gossips, and elephant poachers are alike?
Why dried flowers, some teens, and a delayed shipment of undergarments are alike?
